name: Cellar Ladder and Descent v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Owner-standard shape reference vs scale-locked custom-topology Blender family
review_note: The Blender family preserves the compact masonry descent, leaning twin rails, seven fitted rungs, hand-hewn construction, rear landing portal, dark opening, readable iron fasteners and warm flat-shaded palette. Numeric authority comes from the 1.9-tile player contract rather than the concept's exaggerated figure scale: the rail is 2.256 tiles high, the clear rung width is 0.60 tile, and the whole family remains nearly one tile deep.
improve: Keep the opening buried flush with the runtime floor, retain the dark recessed parallax, and preserve the seven-rung count and current character-relative dimensions.
